roi_summary: Baukjen can expect significant commercial benefits from implementing the full roadmap over 15 weeks. Phase 1 (weeks 1-3) will deliver improved product description writing, automated review collection, and returns reason capture, resulting in increased customer satisfaction and reduced returns rates. Phase 2 (weeks 4-8) will introduce a size guide chatbot and WhatsApp styling assistant, enhancing the customer experience and driving sales. Finally, phase 3 (weeks 9-15) will implement AI demand forecasting and dynamic pricing engine, optimizing inventory management and pricing strategy to maximize revenue.
